regime.label: Stressed, still above our VIX limit
regime.summary: Thu: Europe closed up about 1.8% (Stoxx 600 about 637) on relief that US tariffs will be capped at deal rates (EU 15%). US closed Thu, half day Fri; S&P futures about +0.3%. Brent about $96, gold about $3,570. VIX last seen 28.3 (Wed), above our 25 limit.

brief: US is closed today and Friday is a half day closing 22:00 Dubai; VIX closed 28.3 Wed, so no lab trade and no rocket. Nothing to buy: hold Nvidia, keep the $78.50 SPYM limit, all other ideas stay WAIT or WATCH.

todo.focus: US half day (closes 22:00 Dubai). No new order. Hold Nvidia, keep the $78.50 SPYM limit.

items.text: Open the Radar at 18:15 for the 9:00 ET update before the US open (18:30 Dubai)
Half day: no lab trade, no rocket while VIX is above 25 (28.3 Wed close)

cards.name: S&P 500 ETF (SPYM)
cards.trigger: WAIT. Keep the limit BUY 6 SPYM at $78.50, good till Wed Dec 9. Do not raise it: VIX is near 30. If not filled after the Fed, a new limit on Dec 10.
cards.story: The 500 biggest US companies for 0.02% a year. About 8.6% below its high after a -6% month.

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order. BUY only if the final US text keeps Swiss duty at or below 15%, Hermes makes no new low under EUR 1,213 and CFR closes at or below CHF 170.
cards.story: Net profit +39% while luxury peers grow 1-2%. Q2 slowed to +13%; analyst average target about CHF 210.

cards.name: Eaton
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order. It closed $317.81, near its 52-week low of $308.22. Reconsider only after 2 closes in a row above $330, then red team first.
cards.story: Sales +28% (organic +19%), full-year guide raised. About 31% below its high at about 22x next year's profit.

cards.name: Alphabet
cards.trigger: The $288 limit filled. WATCH on a second slice: no new order until the 2027 capex figure (early Feb) and search growth of at least 12%.
cards.story: Cloud sales doubled (+103%) and search still grew 12%. The Oct 29 profit miss was partly an $8.7B one-off investment loss.

cards.name: Infineon · Xetra
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order. Thursday's +4% is a market-wide tariff-relief bounce. Reconsider only after 3 closes in a row above EUR 48.50 and no new US chip export rule.
cards.story: Guides next year +22% on data-center power chips, but the cash flow guide is about 20% below hopes. The drop is chip-sector mood.

cards.name: Intuitive Surgical (da Vinci)
cards.trigger: WAIT. When VIX closes below 25: red team first, then BUY 1 with a limit at $415 or the last close, whichever is lower.
cards.story: Healthcare leader outside AI chips: revenue +22%, procedures about +15%. Trades about 29% below its 52-week high of $603.88.

cards.name: Microsoft
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order now. After the Fed decision (Wed Dec 9): BUY 1 with a limit at $460, only if VIX is below 25 and MSFT has not closed below $440.
cards.story: Revenue grows about 19% with Azure +48%. But bookings fell and capex is about $170B a year, so buy only lower.

cards.name: Schneider Electric · Paris
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order (new 52-week low Wed). Cancel any old EUR 235 limit. After full-year results (late Feb 2027): BUY 2 at EUR 224 if a cash-flow guide is given.
cards.story: Organic growth +16.9%, record backlog, guidance raised. Fell on the PTC deal financing, not slower demand.

cards.name: TSMC
cards.trigger: WAIT. BUY 1 only after a close above $385, with a limit at that close or $395, whichever is lower. Adds AI-chip exposure.
cards.story: October sales +59.7%, Jan-Oct +43.3%. The drop is chip-sector mood, not TSMC news.

cards.name: ASML
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider after Q4 results and the 2027 outlook (about Jan 27) only if the MATCH Act has not passed and 2027 sales are guided above 2026.
cards.story: Fell with the AI chip selloff. A US bill could ban DUV tool sales and service in China: a rule risk, so mixed.

cards.name: SAP
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider after Q4 results (late Jan 2027) only if current cloud backlog growth stays at 25% or more; red team first.
cards.story: Down about 11% in a week. Cloud is fine, but support, licenses and services shrink and backlog growth is guided to slow. Mixed.

cards.name: Texas Instruments
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider after the Q4 report (about Jan 26) only if the Q1 guide grows vs Q4 and VIX is below 25; red team first.
cards.story: Fell 11% with Analog Devices' flat outlook. Own numbers are strong (Q3 revenue +28%) but the Q4 guide is flat: mixed.

cards.name: STMicroelectronics · Paris
cards.trigger: WATCH. No order. Reconsider after Q4 results (late Jan 2027) only if the Q1 guide grows, gross margin is at least 39% and distributor stock does not rise.
cards.story: About 51% below its high after the European chip selloff. Q3 sales +17.9%, but growth leans on distributor restocking.

cards.name: Computacenter · London
cards.trigger: WATCH. No order. Reconsider at full-year results (March 2027) only if gross margin stops falling and Managed Services grows again; red team first.
cards.story: Fell 8.2% after its investor day. Profit guide was raised, but gross profit lags revenue and Managed Services shrank 4.5%.

cards.name: Equinor · Oslo
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider after Q4 results (Feb 3, 2027) only if Bacalhau and Visund are back online and 2027 output growth is guided at 3% or more.
cards.story: Q3 profit doubled, but field outages cut 2026 output growth to about 3% and oil is about 12% lower in a month. Mixed.

cards.name: EVENT: Rheinmetall investor day
cards.trigger: AVOID. No buy before or during the capital markets day (Nov 26-27). Reconsider only if 2030 targets are kept and it makes 2 weekly closes above EUR 810.
cards.story: A business drop after two guidance cuts. Brokers expect the 2030 sales target to be cut; the event can move the stock hard either way.

agenda.event: US markets closed (Thanksgiving); Rheinmetall capital markets day (Nov 26-27)
CrowdStrike, Marvell, Credo (after close); Huang meets House committees; euro-area inflation; US ISM
Senate hearing with Huang requested (date not confirmed)
Comment deadline on the US Section 301 tariff plan
